messages:
ana: Heads-up: planning to UNPIN runtime v4.1 from canary for model binding tests at 2024-06-18T09:30:00Z. Need ops + SDK check.

vik: Any immediate risks? last run had a small increase in tail CPU on short prompts.

ana: typo - I meant ana. The risk is small-tail latency; we want to unpin so the canary picks up the new kernel routing.

sre-jorge: Observability: therewas a 2x spike in grpc resets in ap-southeast-1 earlier. Recommend a 10m staged ramp and telemetry slice for first 10k reqs. Abort if p95 > 180ms or grpc_reset_rate > 0.4%.

ana: deploy-bot schedule request: unpin runtime=v4.1 env=canary when=2024-06-18T09:30:00Z ramp=[10,50,100] ramp_interval=300s telemetry_slice=canary-runtime-20240618-01 abort=[p95>180ms,grpc_reset>0.4%].

deploy-bot: automated: schedule received. Will emit 5m pre-start and hold/unhold on abort signals.

vik: SDK note: platform-sdks >=3.2 have header shim; block full ramp if sampled sdk<=3.1 > 1%.

sre-jorge: I'll monitor host steal and gpubusy. If gpu_memory_pressure or cpu_steal > 12% abort.

ana: ok final: ramp 10/50/100, abort signals set, SDK gate added. Proceeding unless we see red.

deploy-bot: 5m notice sent. Good luck! :rocket:
